class.name: GoapPlanner
class.brief_description: Searches for the cheapest sequence of actions that reaches a goal.

method.name: get_last_iterations
method.description: Returns the number of search nodes the last query expanded. When it equals [member max_iterations], the search ran out of budget rather than proving the goal unreachable, and raising the limit may produce a plan.

method.name: plan
method.description: Returns a plan for the highest priority goal that is valid, not yet satisfied and reachable, or [code]null[/code] when no goal qualifies. Goals are tried from the highest [member GoapGoal.priority] down, ties being broken by their order in [param goals]. Goals that are already satisfied need no work and are passed over.

method.name: plan_for_goal
method.description: Returns a plan for [param goal] alone, ignoring priorities. Returns [code]null[/code] when the goal cannot be reached, and a plan with no actions when it is already satisfied.

members.member: How many search nodes a single query may expand before giving up. It bounds the time planning can take when a goal is unreachable through a large action set.
The longest chain of actions the planner will build. Plans much longer than a handful of steps tend to be invalidated by the world before they finish, so a low limit is usually the right call.
